capabilities: Poll the vault every 8 seconds for files added or changed on disk
Reconcile new external files into the file explorer, search, and graph view
Update open tabs whose file content changed outside Obsidian
Run an on-demand scan via the Refresh vault now command
Retry failed reconciliations on the next poll
disambiguation: Not a sync service; it only makes Obsidian aware of files already written to disk by outside processes.
extras: Uses vault.adapter.reconcileFile(), an undocumented internal Obsidian API that may break with future versions. Desktop only. Polling interval can only be changed by editing main.js.
intentEvidence: The community Auto Refresh plugin addresses a related issue but requires explicitly listing each folder to watch
problem: Obsidian's filesystem watchers miss external file changes in some environments (Flatpak, network drives, restricted inotify), so new files don't appear and open tabs show stale content until a restart or manual reopen.

relations.evidence: The community Auto Refresh plugin addresses a related issue but requires explicitly listing each folder to watch

summary: Background poller that scans the vault every 8 seconds to pick up files created or changed on disk outside Obsidian.
